                    best_x = x.copy()
                    report_best(best_val, best_x)
            return best_val, best_x

            evals += 1
            fitness[i] = val

                best_x = x.copy()

                    fitness[i] = val

                        best_x = trial.copy()
                        report_best(best_val, best_x)
            if improved:
                no_improve = 0

                no_improve += 1
